repairs.old_fragment:
K t • (DomAddAct.mk (-t) +ᵥ f) =
          K t • ((DomAddAct.mk (-t) +ᵥ f - f) + f) := by
        exact congrArg (fun x : AmbientPlaneL2 ↦ K t • x)
          (sub_add_cancel (DomAddAct.mk (-t) +ᵥ f) f).symm
      _ = K t • (DomAddAct.mk (-t) +ᵥ f - f) + K t • f :=
        smul_add _ _ _
